aria: Animated recap of the Celtics' 117 to 97 road win at Milwaukee: Paul George's go-ahead three with 11:21 left in the first half, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 27 points, the top scorers, how the Celtics won, and the next game at Philadelphia.
notes: Box score from the Celtics' 117–97 win over the Milwaukee Bucks in Milwaukee on Nov 8, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (via WHDH), The Boston Globe and Yahoo Sports. All 117 Celtics points and all 97 Bucks points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (halftime 58–45, as the AP and the Globe report). Boston's 23-point lead (70–47 early in the third quarter) is from the Globe and Covers; Milwaukee's 14-point lead (20–6 in the first quarter) is from the AP and the Globe. Milwaukee's 1–9 start, its worst since 1993–94, is from the AP. The 76ers' record and the Celtics' standing are from the site's standings.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Paul George's three with 11:21 left in the first half (Yahoo Sports), which gave Boston a 28–27 lead in the opening minute of the second quarter (the AP); Boston did not trail again (Yahoo Sports). The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Boston Celtics or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to George’s listed 6-foot-8 and 230 pounds (FOX Sports), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-11¼ wingspan at the 2010 draft combine (NBADraft.net), in the Celtics' road kit. His No. 13 is from NBC Sports Boston. His look isn't on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
